jds.title: AI Developer / Consultant (GenAI)
jds.text:
AI Developer / Consultant (GenAI) — Nuvora AI Labs
Location: Bengaluru · Hybrid | Experience: 3–6 years | CTC: ₹22–35 LPA

About the company
Nuvora AI Labs builds generative-AI solutions for banks, retailers and SaaS companies, from proof of concept to production. We need an AI developer who can also sit with clients, scope problems and explain trade-offs in plain language.

Responsibilities
- Design, build and deploy LLM-powered applications: RAG chatbots, document-processing pipelines and AI agents
- Work directly with client stakeholders to scope use cases, define success metrics and present solutions
- Choose and integrate models through APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini) and open-source LLMs
- Build retrieval pipelines with vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, FAISS) and measure answer quality
- Ship production services with FastAPI, Docker and AWS or GCP, with monitoring and cost controls
- Set up evaluation, guardrails and prompt-engineering practices to improve accuracy and safety
- Mentor junior developers and contribute to reusable solution accelerators

Must-have
- 3–6 years of software or ML engineering experience, including 1+ year building LLM applications
- Strong Python; experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex or similar frameworks
- Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings and vector databases
- Experience deploying APIs and services on AWS, GCP or Azure (Docker, CI/CD)
- Ability to explain AI concepts and trade-offs to non-technical clients
- B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or a related field

Good to have
- Experience evaluating or fine-tuning LLMs (RAGAS, LLM-as-judge)
- Agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI) or tool-calling workflows
- Prior consulting or client-facing delivery experience
- AWS Machine Learning or Google Cloud ML certification

Key skills: Python, LLM apps (RAG, agents), LangChain / LlamaIndex, Vector databases, FastAPI & cloud (AWS/GCP), Client consulting

jds.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
jds.text:
Talent Acquisition Specialist — Brightline Technologies
Location: Gurugram · Hybrid (3 days in office) | Experience: 3–5 years | CTC: ₹10–14 LPA

About the company
Brightline Technologies is a 600-person B2B SaaS company building workflow software for logistics teams. We are doubling our engineering and sales teams this year and need a recruiter who can own hiring from first conversation to joining day.

Responsibilities
- Own end-to-end recruitment for 8–12 open roles at a time across engineering, sales and operations
- Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, interview plans and scorecards
- Source passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, referrals and campus networks
- Screen candidates, coordinate interview loops and keep every candidate informed at each stage
- Track and improve hiring metrics: time-to-hire, offer-acceptance rate and offer-to-joining ratio
- Manage offers, salary negotiation and pre-joining engagement to reduce dropouts
- Maintain clean, compliant data in our ATS (Greenhouse) and share weekly hiring dashboards
- Contribute to employer branding through LinkedIn content, job posts and campus events

Must-have
- 3–5 years of end-to-end recruitment experience, ideally in a tech or SaaS company
- Hands-on with LinkedIn Recruiter and at least one ATS (Greenhouse, Workday, Lever or similar)
- Proven record of closing technical and non-technical roles within agreed timelines
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Comfort with data: Excel or Google Sheets dashboards for hiring metrics
- MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent experience

Good to have
- Experience with campus hiring programmes
- Exposure to diversity hiring initiatives
- Familiarity with AI sourcing tools
- Employer-branding or recruitment-marketing experience

Key skills: End-to-end hiring, LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS (Greenhouse/Workday), Stakeholder management, Hiring metrics, Employer branding

jds.title: Data Analyst
jds.text:
Data Analyst — Finpeak Payments
Location: Bengaluru · On-site | Experience: 2–4 years | CTC: ₹12–18 LPA

About the company
Finpeak Payments processes over 5 million UPI and card transactions a day for 40,000 merchants. Our analytics team turns that data into decisions for product, risk and growth teams.

Responsibilities
- Write efficient SQL to extract and analyse large transaction datasets (100M+ rows)
- Build and maintain Power BI dashboards for product, growth and risk teams
- Design and analyse A/B tests for onboarding and checkout experiments
- Clean, model and analyse data in Python (pandas, NumPy) to answer business questions
- Define and track core metrics: activation, retention, transaction success rate and churn
- Present insights and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders
- Automate recurring reports and improve data quality checks

Must-have
- 2–4 years of experience as a data or business analyst
- Strong SQL (joins, window functions, CTEs) and working Python for analysis
- Experience building dashboards in Power BI or Tableau
- Solid grasp of statistics and experiment design (A/B testing)
- Ability to explain findings clearly to business stakeholders
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics, economics or a related field

Good to have
- Fintech, payments or e-commerce domain experience
- Experience with dbt, Airflow or BigQuery
- Basic knowledge of machine learning (regression, classification)
- Microsoft PL-300 or Google Data Analytics certification

Key skills: SQL, Python (pandas), Power BI / Tableau, A/B testing, Statistics, Stakeholder communication

jds.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jds.text:
Digital Marketing Manager — Leafy Living
Location: Mumbai · Hybrid | Experience: 4–6 years | CTC: ₹16–22 LPA

About the company
Leafy Living is a fast-growing D2C home and plant-care brand with ₹60 crore annual revenue, selling through its own website and marketplaces. We are looking for a digital marketing manager to scale profitable growth.

Responsibilities
- Own performance marketing across Meta and Google with a monthly budget of ₹50 lakh+
- Improve ROAS and reduce customer acquisition cost (CAC) through testing and optimisation
- Plan and run full-funnel campaigns: prospecting, retargeting and retention
- Lead SEO and content strategy to grow organic traffic
- Set up tracking and reporting in GA4 and build weekly performance dashboards
- Run email and WhatsApp marketing automation for retention and repeat purchase
- Manage a team of 3 executives and coordinate with creative and agency partners

Must-have
- 4–6 years in digital or performance marketing, ideally in D2C or e-commerce
- Hands-on management of Meta Ads and Google Ads budgets of ₹25 lakh+/month
- Strong command of ROAS, CAC, LTV and conversion-rate metrics
- Experience with GA4 and marketing dashboards
- Experience leading a small team
- Graduate; MBA in Marketing preferred

Good to have
- Marketplace advertising (Amazon, Flipkart)
- Marketing automation tools (Klaviyo, MoEngage, WebEngage)
- SEO tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush)
- Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications

Key skills: Performance marketing, Meta & Google Ads, ROAS / CAC, SEO, GA4, Marketing automation
